subject: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Team —

I want to share a proposal for a staggered launch for this year's review window. We're calling the sequencing 'Orbit' to emphasize phased outreach for privileged roles, contractors with special terms, and off-cycle promotions. The goal is to limit exposure of sensitive compensation data, reduce manager load spikes, and give People Ops a clean audit trail for unusual cases.

Key items attached: Orbit_launch_timeline_v1.xlsx (proposed dates), manager_talking_points_Orbit.docx, and an off-cycle_form_template.pdf for any non-standard review (rapid promotion, role change mid-cycle).

High-level ask: please review timeline and the off-cycle template, flag any legal/compliance risks, and confirm whether managers should receive scripts one week before their team windows.

Proposed sample sequencing (see sheet A):
- Phase A (privileged): managers with direct reports in Security, Legal, Exec assistants — launch June 2–9
- Phase B (core): product & infra teams — June 10–23
- Phase C (broad): remaining org — June 24–July 7

Concise decision points I need back by EOD Friday (May 7):
1) Are dates ok for Phase A?
2) Off-cycle form sufficient for org/legal signoff?
3) Any objections to manager scripts distribution timing?

Thanks — I tried to keep this compact.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior People Manager, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Kimberly —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a skim of the timeline:
- Phase A window looks reasonable, but can we shift the start a day earlier (June 1) so managers have the full week before the holiday sprint? That reduces overlap with product ship dates.
- Off-cycle form looks fine, but we should add a required field for 'data retention justification' when compensation is exposed.

I'll open a brief comment pass on the sheet. If legal needs extra signoff for promotions into Exec-assistant band, loop them in.

-David
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Kimberly / David —

Thanks. Two items from risk/comms perspective:
1) Manager scripts: please include an explicit FAQ line about 'what to do if a report asks for compensation comparators' and a single-sentence escalation path. Managers need one-liners they can use in 30s.
2) Masking: for Phase A, we should mask salary ranges in the manager view and only surface a verification token to People Ops. I can work with IT on this; will need to know exact dates for implementation at least 10 business days ahead.

Grace
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Looping Legal and a short vendor note here. Two quick updates:
- Legal needs the off-cycle form to include a signature line for a People Ops approver and a checkbox for 'requires external counsel review' for any role that touches customer data.
- I'll start a DocuSign envelope for manager attestations after we finalize the timeline (link to follow).

Also: Tina Alvarez (People Ops consultant) suggested a short pilot with two teams in Phase A to validate manager scripts; recommend we do that the week prior to Phase A start.

Marissa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Thanks all — summary of decisions and next steps: 

DECISIONS (as of 7 May):
- Phase A will start June 1 (David's suggestion).
- Add 'data retention justification' and People Ops sign-off to the off-cycle form (per David/Marissa).
- Manager scripts will include the 'comp comparator' FAQ line (Grace), and we will pilot scripts with two Phase A teams the week of May 24.
- Legal will be added to any off-cycle approvals where customer data access is relevant (Marissa).

ACTION ITEMS:
1) Kimberly: update Orbit_launch_timeline_v2.xlsx with new dates and push to Drive (deliver by Mon May 10).
2) Marissa: open DocuSign envelope for manager attestations once timeline is final.
3) Grace: scope masking requirement with IT and confirm feasibility by May 17.
4) David: add the retention justification field to off-cycle_form_template.pdf and return a draft.

Attachments: I'm attaching the updated talking points draft (manager_talking_points_Orbit_v1_annotated.docx) with inline questions for the pilot managers.

Will follow up on Monday with updated files.

Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit: staggered review launch sequencing + off-cycle forms

Quick note: I've created the DocuSign envelope and queued the manager-attestation doc. Link: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope/SignRequest-987654

I also added a checklist item to require managers to confirm that off-cycle promotions have been discussed with their skip-level for transparency. Happy to adjust language if folks prefer 'informed' vs 'discussed.'

-Marissa
